description_for_human: Access USDA soil data, EPA water quality, AI crop recommendations, carbon credit calculations, precision agriculture tools, patent-pending environmental impact analysis, and multi-parameter planting optimization for any US county.
description_for_model: LeafEngines provides geo-specific agricultural intelligence for the United States. It offers 9 tools: county_lookup (resolve names to FIPS codes), get_soil_data (USDA soil composition), agricultural_intelligence (AI crop recommendations), territorial_water_quality (EPA water quality), safe_identification (plant ID with toxic lookalike warnings), carbon_credit_calculator (carbon credit estimation), generate_vrt_prescription (variable rate prescription maps), environmental_impact_analysis (patent-pending multi-source fusion of USDA/EPA/NOAA/AlphaEarth satellite embeddings producing Environmental Compatibility Scores unavailable from any single public source), and planting_optimization (multi-parameter phenology model for optimal planting windows, yield predictions, and sustainability scores). All locations use 5-digit FIPS county codes — call county_lookup first if the user provides a name.
